result.topic_en: A reference note to the Göttingen Society's Commentationes, a note 'cav. Stern', and Riemann's name and address in ink, with upside-down pencil calculations of partial derivatives of coordinates (apparently rotation-type linear expressions) that are mostly illegible.
result.transcription:
cav. Stern
Commentationes soc. Reg. Gott. rec. Vol. 1. 2.
B Riemann, stud math
[-Notha[?]-] Judenstr.[?] Justi[?]

[pencil, upside down, largely illegible:]
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial r} = az - cx$[?]
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial r} = cy - bz$[?]
$\frac{\partial y}{\partial r} = bx - ay$[?]
$a\frac{\partial r}{\partial x} + b\frac{\partial r}{\partial y} + c\frac{\partial r}{\partial z} = 0$[?]
$bk - cc + gg$[?]
$ck - ak + gf$[?]
[-$ak - bk + gg = 0$-][?]
$kg + cf + rk = 0$[?]
$ax + by + cz$[?]
$\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial \psi}$[?] ...

methods.what: Partial derivatives of coordinates expressed as linear (rotation-like) combinations of coordinates; reading is uncertain
